purpose: Per-address geometry reference for East 7th–East 12th, Second Avenue–Avenue A NYC game expansion. Reference observations only; no source images licensed for game redistribution.
scope_notes: 293–345 East 10th Street including 299 and 331 NYPL are east of Avenue A, outside this rectangle. Do not position the Tompkins Square Library within the requested 10 blocks.

Street numbering is not consistent across the neighborhood: East 10th uses the 200s between Second Avenue and Avenue A; East 9th/11th/12th use the 300s and 400s. St Marks uses its own numbers. Use address geocoding/parcel coordinates, not number-based interpolation.
The source dates below describe observed/reference conditions, not a guarantee of 2026 storefronts.
This is a reference sample with specific facades/storefronts across all six cross streets, not an exhaustive photographic survey of every parcel.
Downloaded reference photos and PDF pages in this scratch folder are for private observation only. Do not ship them as textures.
